title: Fix all CI build and test errors
body:
Fixes all CI build and test errors affecting the `main` branch.

## Root Cause Analysis

**Primary blocker (affects ALL CI workflows):**
`apps/studio/package.json` has `@objectstack/service-ai@workspace:*` as a dependency, but `pnpm-lock.yaml` was never updated to include this entry in the `apps/studio` section. This causes `ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE` on every CI run with `--frozen-lockfile`.

**Secondary issue:**
`@objectstack/service-ai#test` was failing because `vercel-stream-encoder.test.ts` still expected the old v5 Vercel Data Stream Protocol format (`0:"text"\n`) while the encoder had been upgraded to the v6 SSE UI Message Stream Protocol (`data: {"type":"text-delta",...}\n\n`).

## Changes Made

- **`pnpm-lock.yaml`**: Regenerated to include the missing `@objectstack/service-ai@workspace:*` dependency for `apps/studio`.
- **`packages/services/service-ai/src/__tests__/vercel-stream-encoder.test.ts`**: Updated all test assertions to match the v6 SSE UI Message Stream Protocol, including the new lifecycle preamble/postamble (`start → start-step → text-start → events → text-end → finish-step → finish → [DONE]`) and SSE frame format.

## Testing

- ✅ Full monorepo build passes (`pnpm run build` — 43/43 tasks)
- ✅ All tests pass (`pnpm run test` — all packages, including 176 service-ai tests)
